title: Unblocked Games Hub Library
description: Collection of unblocked games stored as iframe configurations and embeds

games.title: Retro Snake
games.description: The legendary vintage Nokia snake arcade game. Eat red apples, grow your tail, and avoid walls or crashing into yourself!
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to move • Space to pause

games.title: 2048 Classic
games.description: Slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one! Can you reach 2048?
games.controls: Arrow Keys / WASD or Swipe to slide tiles

games.title: Flappy Wings
games.description: Tap or press space to flap your wings and navigate through the green pipes without crashing.
games.controls: Spacebar, Up Arrow, or Click to flap

games.title: Space Invaders
games.description: Defend planet Earth from waves of descending alien fleets! Move your battle cannon left and right and blast the invaders.
games.controls: Left/Right or A/D to move • Space to Fire

games.title: Falling Tetra
games.description: Arrange falling tetromino shapes into solid horizontal rows to clear lines and score massive combo points.
games.controls: Left/Right to move • Up to rotate • Down to soft drop • Space for hard drop

games.title: Breakout Arcade
games.description: Bounce the steel ball against colorful brick walls using your paddle. Clear every single brick to triumph!
games.controls: Mouse or Left/Right Arrow Keys to move paddle

games.title: T-Rex Desert Run
games.description: The iconic desert runner. Jump over sharp cacti and duck under flying pterodactyls as speed escalates.
games.controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump • Down Arrow to duck

games.title: Asteroids 1979
games.description: Navigate your geometric starship in deep space. Shoot large asteroids into fragments while avoiding collisions.

games.title: Tower Stacker
games.description: Stack moving blocks on top of each other with pinpoint precision to build the tallest skyscraper.
games.controls: Click, Tap, or Spacebar to place moving block

games.title: Pong Masters
games.description: Test your paddle reflexes against an intelligent computer AI in fast-paced retro table tennis.
games.controls: Mouse or W/S keys to slide paddle up and down

games.title: Minesweeper
games.description: Uncover clean cells while deducing the hidden positions of dangerous explosive mines using numerical hints.
games.controls: Left Click to reveal • Right Click / Long Press to plant flag

games.title: Tic-Tac-Toe Pro
games.description: Classic 3x3 board game. Play against unbeatable minimax AI or a friend in 2-Player mode.
games.controls: Click on any empty cell to place X or O

games.title: Memory Flip Match
games.description: Flip pairs of hidden emoji cards to find matching pairs in minimal moves.
games.controls: Click cards to flip and find matching pairs

games.title: Hextris Online
games.description: Fast-paced hexagonal puzzle game inspired by Tetris. Rotate the hexagon to catch colored bars and clear 3 in a row.
games.controls: Left and Right Arrow keys or A/D to rotate hexagon
